context: Tests: CRD placement, CRD documentation lookup, CRD pattern reference, values schema, validation hand-off.

checklist.name: CRD in crds directory
checklist.description: The Widget CRD manifest is placed in the chart's `crds/` directory.

checklist.name: CRD not templated
checklist.description: The CRD file contains no template expressions and nothing is placed under `templates/` for it.

checklist.name: ServiceMonitor templated
checklist.description: The ServiceMonitor instance lives under `templates/` and is templated.

checklist.name: ServiceMonitor is optional
checklist.description: The ServiceMonitor is gated by an `enabled` flag in `values.yaml` with a documented default.

checklist.name: CRD patterns reference read
checklist.description: The agent reads the CRD patterns reference before writing the ServiceMonitor.

checklist.name: Documentation lookup order
checklist.description: For fields not in the reference, the agent tries Context7 first and falls back to a web search for the operator, kind and version.

checklist.name: Fields verified
checklist.description: The apiVersion and required spec fields of the ServiceMonitor match the retrieved documentation.

checklist.name: Names and labels via helpers
checklist.description: The ServiceMonitor uses the fullname and labels helpers rather than literals.

checklist.name: Values schema provided
checklist.description: A `values.schema.json` is created from the values schema template and covers the new values.

checklist.name: Validation delegated
checklist.description: The agent hands the chart to the helm-validator skill and renders the output through a manifest validator before finishing.
